_comment: Single source of truth for every colour and canvas size the renderers use. cards.py and adspot.py read from here; neither may hold a colour literal.

_provenance.decision: Deliberate MARKETING variant, approved 2026-07-28. These are social collateral, not app chrome: Nebula's --bg (#12121f) is a near-black UI surface, while the violet-tinted gradient below reads better as a card. The divergence is intentional and documented, not drift.

anchored_to_product.violet: Nebula --blue in apps/web/src/app/globals.css. This is THE brand colour and must not diverge — tests/test_brand_tokens.py pins it. If the product changes --blue, change it here too.

size_notes.ig: 4:5 — Instagram feed, the tallest ratio IG renders without cropping
size_notes.square: 1:1 — LinkedIn square; also safe on every network
size_notes.portrait: 4:5 — LinkedIn portrait; same canvas as ig, kept as a separate name so LinkedIn sizing can move without touching Instagram
